# GraphQL Security Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Others > GraphQL

## Overview

Implements GraphQL security with query depth limiting, complexity analysis, rate limiting, and input validation for production APIs

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [graphql-security-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
graphql-security-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@graphql-security-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Implement query depth limiting
- Configure query complexity analysis
- Set up rate limiting per client
- Implement field-level authorization

## Technology Standards Applied

- **GraphQL Security**: OWASP GraphQL security guidelines
- **Query Limits**: Depth and complexity limitation
- **Authorization**: Field-level access control patterns
